title: Fantasia
identity: Boris Mersson, Fantasia op. 37, for alto saxophone and piano. The Antwerp conservatory holdings list identifies the 1981 Kunzelmann score and part, dedication to Iwan Roth, and 1979 composition date. A separate orchestral version also appears in catalog evidence.

evidence.claim: The Paris Philharmonie saxophone repertoire guide identifies Fantasia op. 37 for alto saxophone and piano and describes an adagio leading into a rhythmically driven allegro.
evidence.source_name: Philharmonie de Paris, 10 ans avec le saxophone

evidence.claim: A Belgian conservatory library lists a 1981 Kunzelmann piano score and part, dedicated to Iwan Roth, and separately a 1982 30-page alto saxophone and orchestra score.
evidence.source_name: Conservatoire Royal de Bruxelles/Antwerp library repertoire list

evidence.claim: Current retail catalog identifies Kunzelmann edition for alto saxophone and piano, ISMN 9790206210983.
The Antwerp Conservatory library lists Fantasia per sassofono alto e pianoforte, op. 37, Zurich: Edition Albert J. Kunzelmann, 1981; one score and one part; dedicated to Iwan Roth; composed 1979.
evidence.source_name: Conservatoire Royal de Bruxelles / Antwerp saxophone holdings list

evidence.claim: On printed page 87 (PDF page 82), the guide identifies Mersson’s Fantasia, Op. 37, for alto saxophone and piano and characterizes its form as an Adagio flowing into a rhythmic Allegro. The entry gives no study-year placement.
evidence.source_name: Philharmonie de Paris, 10 ans avec le saxophone

review_focus: Inference: the Philharmonie guide’s Adagio-to-Allegro outline makes sustained lyricism, rhythmic drive, and a style change reasonable listening questions; no score passage was inspected.
collection_flag: Original alto saxophone work; an orchestral version also exists. The target piano edition is identified, though its notation remains inaccessible.
gaps: Readable score preview and a matching saxophone recording were not verified.
searches: Antwerp saxophone repertoire PDF Mersson Fantasia 1979
